_comment: Static world content: the village, the sealed rival ground, the landmarks, and -- since R2a -- fifteen lootable sites. Positions are WORLD CELLS (the settlement's own buildings use settlement cells and live in buildings.json). Sites do not block movement; you walk through the village, you do not walk around it.
_comment_lootable:
The optional `lootable` block is LOOT_SITES_SPEC.md section 8. FIFTEEN ACTIVE SITES, which is the top of ROGUELITE_REWORK section 4's 10-15 active budget -- section 2's per-type 'per run' numbers are POOL bounds the R4 shuffle draws from and deliberately sum past it (~25), not additive targets. Thirteen types are represented once each, plus a second fresh grave and a second wolf den. `pool` and `active_count` are specified now and honoured in R4 (section 8), so the shuffle will not have to reopen this schema.

TERRAIN TELEGRAPHS, PATHS DO NOT (section 3 + the 2026-08-06 amendment): the crypt sits on the ruins the generator paints under it, the battlefield on charred ground, the church cemetery inside the church grounds. `signposted: true` earns a worn dirt track and is legal on Band 1-2 ONLY -- tools/make_world_map.gd hard-errors on a Band 3 or 4 site that sets it. THE ROAD PROMISE (designer ruling, 2026-08-27 human check): a road always has something at its end, so every dirt-track terminus is a site with at least one loot action at generation time, and tools/verify_terrain.tscn asserts it.
_comment_guardians: `guardian.kind` selects a statline from the `guardians` table below; a bare string reads as {kind, count: 1} so nothing already written reopens. Every kind wears an AUTHORED RACE ROW -- the wolf wears Wolf.gd's own row and art so a den wolf and a dusk wolf are the same animal, and there is deliberately no bespoke statline in this file. A Band-4 guardian that wants numbers the roster does not have is a workbook row (tools/export_roster.gd), not a JSON invention.

wolf.name: Pack wolf
wolf._comment: Wolf.gd's own numbers: Str 5 / End 5 (18 hp), the flee-below-5 rule, and the one width-scaled sprite in the project (SPRITE_SPEC section 3's quadruped rule). A pack wolf that flees LEAVES THE RUN -- a den's defenders are finite, which is what makes attrition across two visits a legitimate tactic.

crypt_sentinel.name: A dead sentinel
crypt_sentinel._comment: Undead ON PURPOSE, and commandable because of it: Command Undead flipping a crypt's dead sentinel is the fantasy, not a hole in the rules (section 9). It wears the skeleton_worker row because that is the Undead statline the roster actually has; a tougher barrow-guard is a workbook row someone has to author, not a number invented here.

outlaw.name: An outlaw
outlaw._comment: Str 5 / End 5, the human peasant measuring stick -- individually a match for a skeleton and clearly beneath a Warrior-category recruit. The cave is occupied by definition; two of them is the fight.

sites.name: The Lord's Manor
sites.subtitle: Human lordship — Band 3
sites.description: Stone, banners, and a garrison that has never had to prove itself. Taking this is how a run ends well.

details.label: Held by
details.value: The human lord

details.label: Garrison
details.value: Unknown — nobody has counted
The victory condition lives here. There is nothing you can do about it yet.

sites.name: The Church
sites.subtitle: Human lordship — Band 3
sites.description: A bell, a graveyard, and men who read omens for a living. When the world starts whispering your name, this is where it is heard first.

details.label: Interest in you
details.value: None yet
The church investigates in Era II. For now it rings for weddings.

sites.name: The Church Cemetery
sites.subtitle: Consecrated ground — Band 3
sites.description: Consecrated, filled and tended. Every one of them is bones somebody would miss, and the priest lives forty paces that way.

details.label: Graves
details.value: More than you could carry

sites.subtitle: Village
sites.description: Smoke from the chimney, a woodpile, a dog somewhere behind it. Nobody inside has heard of you.

details.value: Static in v1: no routines, no schedule, nobody to meet.

sites.name: The Village Watchtower
sites.subtitle: Village
sites.description: It faces north up the Old Road, which is where trouble has always come from. It does not face west.

details.label: Watches
details.value: The Old Road
Nobody is looking toward your valley. That is the whole of your safety.

sites.name: The Sealed Ritual Ground
sites.subtitle: Something else sleeps here — Band 3
sites.description: A circle cut into the frozen ground, older than the lordship and colder than the weather. It is not yours, and it is not empty. Whatever was called here has been sealed under it, and something else sleeps here still.

details.label: State
details.value: Sealed — dormant

details.label: Yours?
details.value: No
The rival's territory ships sealed (ROGUELITE_REWORK §4 amendment 1): no AI, no spawns, nothing to fight. The Demonologist returns as a playable class, not as an enemy.

sites.name: A Fresh Grave
sites.subtitle: Lair Surroundings — Band 1
sites.description: Turned earth, no marker, and the shovel marks still sharp. Somebody was buried in a hurry and nobody came back.

details.value: The tutorial loot, and the tutorial decision: four ways to leave a grave, and only one of them is free.

sites.name: A Fresh Grave
sites.subtitle: Lair Surroundings — Band 1
sites.description: Piled stones instead of earth, because whoever dug it hit rock at two feet and gave up.

sites.name: A Hidden Cache
sites.subtitle: Lair Surroundings — Band 1
sites.description: Flat stones dragged over something, in a spot chosen by someone who meant to come back for it.

details.value: Coin and small treasure. The wood beside it is what somebody used to cover the hole.

sites.name: The Broken Shrine
sites.subtitle: Contested Wilderness — Band 2
sites.description: Toppled once already, scoured, and older than the road that ignores it. Somebody still leaves offerings here.

details.value: Desecration is loud. Taking the coin and leaving the stone standing is not.

sites.name: An Abandoned Camp
sites.subtitle: Contested Wilderness — Band 2
sites.description: A lean-to, a cold firepit, and more left behind than anyone would leave on purpose. Whoever camped here left in a hurry or did not leave at all.

details.value: Sometimes there are weapons in the packs. Somebody stopped needing them.

sites.name: The Standing Stones
sites.subtitle: Contested Wilderness — Band 2
sites.description: Three of them, leaning, with the snow scoured off the western faces. Nobody in the village remembers who set them, and the ground under them is older still.

details.value: Three pulls, and each one is a fresh chance that something under there objects.

sites.name: A Marked Grave
sites.subtitle: Contested Wilderness — Band 2
sites.description: A proper stone, at the edge of the wood, a long way from anywhere that would have paid for it. Whoever is under it was worth the carry.

sites.name: A Derelict Graveyard
sites.subtitle: Contested Wilderness — Band 2
sites.description: A dozen stones under the snow at the end of a track nobody has walked in years. Whatever village buried these people is not there any more.

details.value: Nobody comes here. Nobody would know. This is where you learn what a grave is worth.

sites.name: The Village Graveyard
sites.subtitle: Village outskirt — Band 3
sites.description: Out past the last field, where the ground is cheap and the wind gets at it. Someone walks out here most weeks with flowers.

sites.name: A Wolf Den
sites.subtitle: Forest clearing — Band 2
sites.description: A hole under a root ball at the end of a corridor of trees, and gnawed bones all the way in. This is where the thing that comes at dusk sleeps.

details.value: Clear every den and the dusk raids stop for the run. That is the reward — the hide is a bonus.

sites.name: A Wolf Den
sites.subtitle: Forest clearing — Band 2
sites.description: Deeper in, and bigger. The pack that lives here has never had a reason to be careful.

sites.name: An Ancient Crypt
sites.subtitle: Nobody goes this far — Band 4
sites.description: A stone door in a mound, in ruins nobody has a name for. Something is inside. The crypt does not pretend otherwise.

details.label: Inside
details.value: Two of them, and they were put there to stay awake
Guaranteed relic, heavy Dark Essence, and a fight with no way around it.

sites.name: An Outlaw Cave
sites.subtitle: Nobody goes this far — Band 4
sites.description: A mouth in the rock with a path worn to it, and a skull on a stake to explain the arrangement. Occupied. Fight or leave.

details.label: Inside
details.value: Two, and they have been up here a long time
The hoard, and weapons you did not have to buy from the Workshop.

sites.name: A Cursed Battlefield
sites.subtitle: Nobody goes this far — Band 4
sites.description: Burnt ground at the foot of the range, and enough bone in it that the snow will not lie flat. Nobody buried anybody here.

details.value: Four pulls, and the more you take the likelier it is that something takes exception.

patrols.name: The Village Watch
patrols.subtitle: Human lordship — patrol
patrols.description: Two rounds a day, the same two rounds his father walked. He is looking for drunks and stray livestock.

patrols.name: The Road Patrol
patrols.subtitle: Human lordship — patrol
patrols.description: Walks the crossroads out and back. The lord pays for the road to be seen to be watched.
